source: Compound (family) parameters for the on-the-fly tyre builder (core/src/tyre_spec.cpp). Qualitative construction/compound inspiration researched from manufacturer sources in docs/tyre_families.md. All force coefficients and speed assignments are authored game fits, not historical measurements or product certifications. There are NO tyre files per size: a tyre is a compound plus a size (width / aspect R rim), built in memory as a ps::vehicle::TyreDesc by one rule from this file; vehicle files carry a tyre spec, cars declare per-axle fitment (rims, width range, diameter tolerance).

rule.note: lambda_mu = lambda_mu_ref * compound grip * (width / reference_width)^grip_width_exponent (longitudinal and lateral with their own compound factor); crr_base = crr_ref * compound resistance * (width / reference_width)^resistance_width_exponent, with the compound's rated speed and the base tyre's rise anchors deriving qsy1/qsy3/qsy4; pkx1/pky1 = base * compound stiffness; fz0 and vertical stiffness scale with the section volume V = width * (D^2 - rim_d^2) (m^3, D the overall diameter = rim diameter + 2 * aspect/100 * width); unloaded radius = D/2, rim radius = rim_in*0.0127 m. Everything else is the base tyre. The compound's rated speed is capped at 270 km/h for rims up to 17 in (passenger-tyre regime).

families.label: Cord Touring
families.description: Natural-rubber and cotton-cord inspiration; simple rib tread, modest grip and a low-speed profile.

families.label: Belted Touring
families.description: Synthetic-rubber and belted-bias inspiration; repeating zigzag blocks, improved road holding.

families.label: Steel Radial
families.description: Steel-belted radial inspiration; conventional block tread and balanced touring behavior.

families.label: Eco Touring
families.description: Modern silica-compound inspiration; fine drainage/siping and low rolling resistance.

families.label: Sport Radial
families.description: Modern performance-compound inspiration; directional tread and stronger dry grip.

families.label: Performance Road
families.description: Existing high-speed road fit; broad drainage channels.

families.label: Track Semi-Slick
families.description: Broad contact patches with sparse grooves for dry track use.

families.label: Drag
families.description: Straight-line traction at the expense of lateral grip.
